design: A is on the RIGHT: one continuous L-shaped civic/service building, with two perpendicular wings and a large open inward notch. The long right wing rises to two storeys, the short rear wing steps down to one storey, making both the ground footprint and overall silhouette clearly ㄱ / L-shaped. One linked building, not two disconnected houses. Pale desaturated green painted concrete, broad clean panels, selective large replacement plates, a supported rounded upper bay, and a recessed entrance. Use a broad mechanical ventilation ridge on the high wing and a supported angled maintenance canopy/service deck on the low wing. Leave the concave ground corner legible and empty. B is on the LEFT: a substantial one-storey urban power/service station with grounded door, and a SECOND STOREY entirely made of salvaged mechanical infrastructure: a tall open support frame carrying a broad vertical heat-exchanger rack, two large pressure/energy modules and connecting service channels. This upper mechanism is floor-sized, visibly bears on the lower building and replaces the second-floor rooms altogether. It is not a few small tanks on a normal house roof. Give the machine a different silhouette from variant1's horizontal rounded compressor assembly. A compact repaired car is parked at the near-right perimeter, never in the center. Put the utility pole along the left perimeter, its conductors routed around the boundary rather than across the central ground. A broad dry concrete/asphalt street court with wide squared paving joints stays empty; sidewalks follow A's L footprint. Front cut sections use broad cable-tray access bays and a separate district-heating manifold.
exits: LEFT transition: an OPEN ground-level service street between B and the short rear wing of A, heading toward the rear-left edge. It is framed by building masses, not a freestanding wall gate. Continue unobstructed paving to the rear-left edge; no fence, boxes or pole in this gap. RIGHT transition: a large CLOSED sliding service door in the inward-facing wall of A's long wing, sharing A's grounded entry and leading through its ground floor toward the rear-right. Keep its approach and side pocket clear; the hidden internal continuation is planned, not exposed. Other domestic and B service doors are ordinary non-transition doors. Close all other rear gaps with short anchored utility barriers meeting the two buildings. Exactly two transitions total.

roof_plan.A: high wing louver ridge + low wing supported canopy/deck, each about half
roof_plan.B: mechanical upper-storey frame and integrated housings, about 65% slab occupancy

exit_states: open street gap, rear-left between A/B
closed sliding entry through A, rear-right
correction_strategy: Two inputs only: new-scene guide controls geometry; same variant appearance is remapped. Remove external camera-bearing source images from correction.
